messages:
Sam K: heads up — multiple customers reporting 502/504s from Hosted API edge over the last ~10m during a traffic spike. seeing 502s from the edge, 504s at some clients. filing here before we get a full incident channel. @Jordan (SRE) can you triage?

Jenna S: customer escalations coming in — two big accounts experiencing timeouts and retries. They say it started after a model rollout ~09:58 PDT and spikes at ~10:05. They attached request ids. Customers blocked on inference in prod.

Jordan (SRE): reading logs now. quick checks: envoy upstream_503_count + upstream_response_time spiking. but also seeing Envoy "upstream response failed" with 502 cause: "recv reset". attaching snippet:```
[2026-03-15T17:05:12Z] envoy upstream response error: code=502, reset_reason=LOCAL_RESET
```

Mike L: I repro locally against staging by replaying traffic burst script — when we hit ~350 rps we see conn pool exhaustion on auth-service and occasional 502s from edge. auth-service logs show too many outbound connections to identity-db.

Rachael P: could be the token validation path. we did add synchronous token introspection in the last release. that might not scale during bursts.

Jordan (SRE): agree. quick mitigation: enable fallback auth cache on edge to avoid hitting auth-service for every request. Can we flip feature flag? @Sam K do we have flag?

Sam K: there is a runtime flag `edge.auth.cache_enabled` currently false for rollout. flipping now to true for hosted-api edges in us-west-2.

ops-bot: deploy-triggered: `edge-config-update` job queued by Sam K — change: edge.auth.cache_enabled=true (target: hosted-edge-prod-us-west-2). job id: deploy-8812.

Jordan (SRE): after flip, seeing immediate reduction in auth-service qps and envoy 502s down ~70% on the affected nodes. customers reporting improved response. still some 504s for long-running requests (>10s).

Jenna S: pushed a message to affected customers: "we're mitigating, temporary cache enabled, investigating full fix" — two customers acknowledged.

Mike L: repro notes for root cause: sequence: rollout introduced sync introspect -> increased per-request latency and DB hits -> auth-service connection pool exhaustion -> auth upstream returning resets -> Envoy mapping resets to 502, and NGINX LB 504s when edge hold queues fill. repro steps: 1) run identity-introspect load with 500 rps for 3m; 2) run hosted-api traffic that performs token-introspect per request; 3) observe connection pool saturation on auth-service; 4) edge starts returning 502/504.

Jordan (SRE): logs to correlate: `envoy.cluster.outlier_events`, `envoy.upstream_cx_overflow`, `authsvc.connections.current`. Grafana dashboards: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/edge/edge-prod-overview?orgId=1 (shared).

Sam K: quick patch plan: (1) keep auth cache enabled for scale mitigation; (2) bump auth-service connection pool limit and add circuit breaker for DB calls; (3) change token introspect to async/queued path for certain routes; (4) update runbook to include auth cache flag for burst mitigation.

Rachael P: engineering follow-ups: ticket ENG-1298 to add async introspection and safe fallback; ENG-1299 to tune connection pool + add instrumentation. Jenna: can you open a customer-facing incident summary once we have RCA?

Jenna S: will do. Draft: "Brief outage: intermittent 502/504s during traffic spike due to increased auth validation load after a recent rollout. Temporary mitigation applied (edge auth cache). Engineers implementing a permanent fix; ETA 48-72h for staged changes."

Jordan (SRE): Additional technical notes: if you see `upstream reset: connection termination` in envoy, check `auth-service` health and DB p99 latency. For immediate mitigation in other regions: enable `edge.auth.cache_enabled` and increase `envoy.upstream.timeout` to avoid flapping during retries.

Mike L: posted repro script in gist: https://gist.github.com/mikel/repro-auth-burst (contains curl loop + token generation). use with care.

Sam K: assigning oncall: @Jordan will continue to own realtime mitigation, Rachael and Mike on fix PRs. I'll coordinate comms. ops-bot created incident INC-2026-0041 and linked thread.

ops-bot: incident created: INC-2026-0041 (priority: P2) — assigned to Jordan (SRE).

Jordan (SRE): next steps checklist: 1) monitor for reoccurence across regions; 2) deploy connection pool bump + circuit breaker to auth-service (canary 20%); 3) postmortem after RCA; 4) update runbook. Will update thread with PR links and timelines.

Jenna S: customers updated at 10:24 PDT. No escalations pending.

Sam K: thanks all — keeping this thread as our single source. will create postmortem stub once RCA confirmed. :thumbsup:
